problems_addressed.solution_summary: Shift focus from proving to others to achieving for personal fulfillment.

episode_summary: Paul Salter discusses the dangers of building success on the need to prove self-worth, highlighting the unsustainable nature of such motivation. He offers insights on shifting focus to personal fulfillment and recalibrating ambition to achieve sustainable success. The episode provides actionable strategies for balancing work and personal life, emphasizing the importance of internal validation.
